metadata.case_name: CHAN HONG NING v. WAI LEE SCAFFOLDING ENGINEERING LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: scaffolder specialising in the dismantling of scaffolds
plaintiff.occupation_after: joiner and carpenter installing false ceilings

injuries.description: a transverse full thickness corneal laceration at the centre of the right cornea
source: the medical evidence is that the injury consisted of a small skin abrasion above the right eye-brow and a transverse full thickness corneal laceration at the centre of the right cornea.
injuries.icd_description: Ocular laceration without prolapse or loss of intraocular tissue, unilateral

injuries.description: traumatic cataract requiring surgical removal and replacement with an intra-ocular lens
source: He has also had to undergo an operation for the surgical removal of a traumatic cataract and its replacement with an intra-ocular lens.

injuries.description: small skin abrasion above the right eye-brow
source: the medical evidence is that the injury consisted of a small skin abrasion above the right eye-brow and a transverse full thickness corneal laceration at the centre of the right cornea.
injuries.icd_description: Abrasion of other or unspecified sites of head

manifestations.description: blurred vision from the right eye
unable to return to previous occupation as a scaffolder

treatments_received: surgical removal of a traumatic cataract and replacement with an intra-ocular lens

losses.description: Permanent damage to the right eye including corneal laceration and traumatic cataract resulting in the right eye being for all intents and purposes useless
Will not be able to return to his previous occupation as a scaffolder specialising in dismantling scaffolds
Will not be able to drive as a result of loss of effective sight in the right eye

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: Loss of effective sight from one eye will cause a considerable loss of confidence and time of reflection and adjustment
